changes: Fixed a thin white translucent strip that sat across the top bar and covered the buttons.
Shelves are just Newest games and Popular games now.
The catalogue cache now actually survives restarts, so the store opens in seconds instead of rebuilding for minutes.
Search and covers got request timeouts, so one stalled Steam call can't freeze a screen.

Site pages like Upcoming Repacks no longer show up as games.

Install free games to any folder, with a real download sheet and browser fallback for hosts that block apps.

Covers and details for free games still come from Steam when the game exists there.
A brand new Vortex logo and app icon.
Signing in with your Vortex Music account works now.
Create a Vortex account right in the app.
A cleaner sign in screen with a show password button.
Games light up with a white outline when you point at them.
No more shimmer sweeping across covers.
Typing in Console Mode no longer closes the panel you're typing in.
Store: browse Steam's top sellers, most played, new releases and deals, by genre, with search.
Shooter games are left out of the Store.
Sign in with your Vortex account to see your profile, quote, bio, status and favourites.
Friends show what they're playing or listening to, and they see the game you're in.
Console Mode opening animation.
Controller buttons show as PlayStation or Xbox buttons, whichever you have plugged in.
On-screen keyboard for searching with a controller.
Real covers for newer Steam games.
Updates now install from inside the app.
The new VORTEX Launcher with Console Mode and Desktop Mode, official game art, favourites and hidden games.
